lines.text: In King Artaxerxes' twentieth year, Nehemiah gave the king his wine, and the king asked why his face was sad.
Nehemiah said his fathers' city lay in ruins, its gates burned, and then he prayed to the God of heaven.
Nehemiah asked to be sent to Judah to rebuild the city, and the king, with the queen beside him, asked how long.
Nehemiah asked for letters to the governors west of the Jordan and to Asaph, keeper of the king's forest.
The king sent army officers and cavalry with Nehemiah, and Sanballat and Tobiah the Moabite official were deeply disturbed.
